nodes.summary: Install the newer official release with an atomic switch and keep the previous binaries for rollback
usage: corvint-update apply --component core|tasks [--allow-network] [--github-token-env NAME] [--bin-dir PATH] [--state-dir PATH] [--refresh-index ROOT]... [--restart-service PROGRAM] [--post-switch CMD]... [--hook-timeout D] [--hook-attempts N] [--drain-timeout D] [--start-timeout D]

nodes.summary: Report whether a newer official release of the component exists; no request leaves the host without --allow-network
usage: corvint-update check --component core|tasks [--allow-network] [--github-token-env NAME] [--bin-dir PATH] [--state-dir PATH] [--refresh-index ROOT]... [--restart-service PROGRAM] [--post-switch CMD]... [--hook-timeout D] [--hook-attempts N] [--drain-timeout D] [--start-timeout D]

nodes.summary: Restore the previous binaries the last apply kept
usage: corvint-update rollback --component core|tasks [--allow-network] [--github-token-env NAME] [--bin-dir PATH] [--state-dir PATH] [--refresh-index ROOT]... [--restart-service PROGRAM] [--post-switch CMD]... [--hook-timeout D] [--hook-attempts N] [--drain-timeout D] [--start-timeout D]
